sentences: Revolving credit utilization is the most important driver of default risk, with a strong effect: risk rises as the share of the credit limit in use goes up, with the largest step at the highest utilization levels.
The number of past delinquencies is the second most important driver, also with a strong effect, and risk rises as the count goes from zero to two or more.
Annual income has a moderate effect, and risk falls as income rises.
Length of credit history has a moderate effect, and risk falls as the history gets longer.
The effect of utilization grows with the number of past delinquencies: the rise in risk from higher utilization is far larger for applicants with two delinquencies than for those with none.
Debt-to-income ratio has a weak effect, with risk rising somewhat at higher ratios.
Age has no effect that the model can detect, and feature_a hardly matters.
The data do not settle whether feature_b has any real effect, or whether feature_a and feature_b interact.
